newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgians have their eye on tax fraud gold medal.
newsitem.headline: Belgians have their eye on tax fraud gold medal.

text.p: Most Belgians would fiddle their taxes given the chance, a survey published on Monday by La Derniere Heure newspaper showed.

"If fraud were an Olympic sport, Belgians would have no problem getting on the highest steps of the rostrum," the newspaper said in its survey of 1,000 people of which 61.4 percent said they would "unscrupulously" commit fiscal fraud.

On average, after taxes and deductions for social security, a Belgian employee is left with just 46.8 percent of pre-tax pay, against 53.6 percent in the Netherlands, 55 percent in France and 67.4 percent in Britain, the paper said.
